page_title: GET 2-1 VIL | Getafe v Villarreal 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' That will be all from Martin Satriano who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Allan Nyom (Getafe).
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
90' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) commits a foul after dangerous play. Villarreal will take a free kick.
87' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle after Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Getafe will take a free kick near the side line.
86' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) has received a yellow card for his foul.
86' Today's match ends for Kiko Femenia who will be replaced by Sebastian Boselli (Getafe).
83' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Free kick. Getafe will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
82' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
82' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle and it's Javier Munoz (Getafe) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Villarreal win a free kick.
81' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
81' The substitution has been made. Adrian Liso (Getafe) has replaced Luis Vazquez.
80' Patricio Moreno Ruiz has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javier Munoz (Getafe) replacing Djene.
80' David Soria (Getafe) is able to continue to play.
78' It's time for a substitution. Alex Freeman (Villarreal) comes on in place of Santiago Mourino.
78' David Soria (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' 2 - 1 Goal! Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 2:1.
76' Post! Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) pounces on the rebound inside the penalty box and tries to prod home! He's unlucky as the ball only rattles the left post.
76' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
76' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
74' A player from Getafe commits a rough challenge. Miguel Sesma blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Villarreal earn a free kick.
73' The ball is cleared after Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
72' Miguel Sesma couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) and blew his whistle. Villarreal have a free kick.
71' The free kick is delivered by Pau Navarro (Villarreal) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
70' Martin Satriano (Getafe) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick to Villarreal.
69' Martin Satriano (Getafe) commits a rough foul. Miguel Sesma stops the game and makes a call. Villarreal win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
68' The resulting corner from Luis Milla (Getafe) comes to nothing.
68' Martin Satriano (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee blows his whistle, Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
65' Marcelino has decided to substitute Dani Parejo and he is replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
65' Substitution. Tajon Buchanan will be replaced by Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal).
64' The resulting corner, taken by Luis Milla (Getafe), comes to nothing.
63' Martin Satriano (Getafe) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

62' The opposition give Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
61' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
60' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
58' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the left post.
58' Luis Milla (Getafe) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for an infringement.
57' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

53' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Martin Satriano (Getafe) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez and scores magnificently from close range into the right side of the goal. 2:0.

52' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Miguel Sesma who sees an offensive foul. It's a free kick to Getafe, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
51' The referee blows his whistle as Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) was too aggressive in his challenge. That's a free kick to Getafe.
49' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Miguel Sesma didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
46' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Marcelino makes a half-time substitution. Ayoze Perez comes on in place of Hugo Lopez (Villarreal).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Getafe is cautioned for aggressive play. It's a free kick to Villarreal in a dangerous position.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
41' 1 - 0 Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) steps up to take the penalty and converts it with a shot into the middle of the goal.
40' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
39' Today's referee Miguel Sesma rightly decides to book Renato Veiga (Villarreal) for his harsh tackle.
39' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Getafe!
38' Referee Miguel Sesma makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Getafe. Let’s see what happens!
38' One of the Getafe players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
38' Having seen unsporting behavior, Miguel Sesma shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Diego Rico (Getafe) is the recipient.
37' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) tackles a bit over-zealously and Miguel Sesma blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Getafe.

36' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Getafe are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
35' Zaid Romero (Getafe) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Miguel Sesma ignores the protests.
34' Martin Satriano (Getafe) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
33' Villarreal are ruled offside.
30' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. Getafe are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
29' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
27' Martin Satriano (Getafe) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

26' Djene (Getafe) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. Villarreal have been awarded a free kick.
24' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
24' Miguel Sesma interrupts the game. One of the players from Villarreal won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Getafe have a free kick.
23' One of the players from Villarreal times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
21' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
20' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
18' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

15' Golden chance! Luis Milla (Getafe) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
15' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Hugo Lopez (Villarreal) makes a strong challenge and Miguel Sesma blows for a foul. Getafe get a free kick.
14' Djene (Getafe) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
13' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

12' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Miguel Sesma no option but to blow his whistle. Getafe are awarded a free kick.
8' Getafe are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
5' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Luiz Junior intercepts the ball.
3' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Hugo Lopez (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Villarreal get a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Villarreal will have the kick-off.
